query: What are the top innovative trends in Health & Medical Sciences related to clinical endpoints, motion modeling, artifact simulation, statistical analysis, and reproducibility?

response.query: What are the top innovative trends in Health & Medical Sciences related to clinical endpoints, motion modeling, artifact simulation, statistical analysis, and reproducibility?
response.answer: Top trends include AI-driven digital twins for clinical trials, 3D-printed models for preoperative planning, and advanced statistical methods for reproducibility. Emphasis on regulatory frameworks for AI in medical imaging and drug discovery is growing. Innovations in motion modeling and artifact simulation enhance imaging accuracy.

results.content: A-MEDICO is delivering health technology solutions in: • Diagnostics for early screening, detection, prevention, and treatment • Health monitoring with a focus on remote locations & those aging or recovering at home • Improved function, mobility, and independence across the lifespan • Healthcare delivery and interventions Contact Us: https://www.A-MEDICO.ca https://www.linkedin.com/company/a-medico amedico@ucalgary.ca BRONZE SPONSORS SUNDAY WORKSHOP PRESENTED TO YOU BY: PROGRAM FRIDAY 12:00 – 2:30 pm Registration 3:00 – 3:10 pm Welcoming Remarks Podium Presentations: Session 1 3:10 – 4:05 pm Session Chairs: Nina Pavlovic & Amber Morrison Modrcin, Dora Cleaved Proteoglycan 4 Impairs Coagulation: Preliminary Evidence Mirkiani, Soroush Depth-Selective Thin-Film Flexible Intraspinal Arrays for Restoring Movement After Spinal Cord Injury: Feasibility and Function Palset, Abbey Assessing Metformin Efficacy in Attenuating Cerebral Hypoxia and Disease Outcomes in a Mouse Model of Multiple Sclerosis using 9.4T MRI Stirling, Callie Standardization and Reproducibility of μFE Models of the Load-Bearing Human Knee Using In Vivo HR-pQCT Wasif, Shahryar More Friends, More Function? Investigating the Effects of Robotic Walking Parameters on Heart Rate Markus Zaplachinski,1 Jessica Youngblood,2 Ana Arantes,1 Christa Diot,3 Elizabeth Condliffe2 1Department of Biomedical Engineering, Schulich School of Engineering, University of Calgary 2Departments of Clinical Neurosciences and Pediatrics, Cumming School of Medicine, University of Calgary 3Alberta Children’s Hospital Introduction Robotic walking has shown promise in facilitating physical activity in people with severe mobility impairments and may decrease health risks associated with inactivity [1].

results.title: Clinical and Biomedical Imaging, Conference Details
results.content: Medical Imaging + Medical Imaging + Medical Imaging + Medical Imaging This conference will cover all aspects of observing, measuring, quantifying and modeling molecular, structural and functional parameters from clinical and biomedical images. * image processing, detection, segmentation, registration, and analysis for quantifying and modeling molecular, structural and functional parameters The Clinical and Biomedical Imaging conference will feature a cum laude poster award. * SPIE Medical Imaging Awards and Plenary SPIE Medical Imaging Awards and Plenary View Full Details: spie.org/medical-imaging-awards-plenary Barrett Award in Medical Imaging**    Session Chairs: Yu Gan, Stevens Institute of Technology (United States), Andrzej Krol, SUNY Upstate Medical Univ. * Image Processing Student Paper Award The proposed method uses a encoder-decoder-based segmentation model as visual encoder to extract blood vessel and lesion (thrombi) regions from two CLSM images. If accepted into the program, a new upload of a 4-page minimum manuscript submission will be due 28 January 2026 for publication in the SPIE Medical Imaging conference proceedings.
